summary: A neighbor starts a recall: {neighbor} wants to lead a recall of {officeholder} over {the decision}, and wants you beside them.
realLife: In 2021 two San Francisco parents with no political experience started a recall of school board members. A housing activist brought fundraising know-how, and in 2022 voters recalled three members.
gates: {the decision} is on record and touched your household.
The place's law allows a recall of {officeholder}.
weights: How much {the decision} cost your household.
Your ties with others it hurt.
choices: sign the petition and no more
say you would rather run for the seat at the next election

branches.when: a child of yours is in the schools and {officeholder} sits on the school board
branches.then: {neighbor} is another parent, met at pickup, and the fight is over what the board did to your child's school.

branches.when: a seasoned campaigner offers money and know-how
branches.then: His price is a say in what the recall says, which changes who it answers to.

branches.when: many families speak another language at home
branches.then: A neighbor offers to gather signatures in it, which reaches voters the campaign could not.

branches.when: you work for the body {officeholder} sits on
branches.then: The recall is aimed at your employer, and {neighbor} wants you inside it.
